dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I hope that you'll meet again soon.

dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, I have some food that I made here. I was going to give them to Miss Kiyoko, but you can have some too.

dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: It's just an ordinary meal, but if you don't mind, please give it a try.
